video_title: Jaylen Wells Walk-Off Interview | Grizzlies vs. Clippers

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells on Memphis Grizzlies' second-half defensive adjustments
quotes.excerpt: I think we had to get our offense going. We were very good defensive half, just had to play both sides of the ball.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Jaylen, they climbed back there at the end of the second quarter, but you took it back to them again in the third and the fourth. What was the difference in the second half?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: I think we had to get our offense going. We were very good defensive half, just had to play both sides of the ball.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells on the Grizzlies second half surge against the Clippers: We had to get our offense going and play both sides of the ball.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells explains the difference in the Grizzlies' performance during the second half of the game.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells explains Memphis Grizzlies' second-half success
quotes.excerpt: I think a lot of it is just wearing out the other team. We play a very intense game.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: As far as second halves, you guys have been very successful in second halves. What leads to that?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: I think a lot of it is just wearing out the other team. We play a very intense game, picking up full court, being disruptive, so I don't think a lot of teams can keep up with that.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells says the Grizzlies success in second halves comes down to conditioning: We play a very intense game and I do not think a lot of teams can keep up with that.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells discusses the team's ability to wear down opponents through intense defensive pressure.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells on Grizzlies' ball movement and depth
quotes.excerpt: We have a lot of weapons. Even with guys out, I think it shows our depth.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: I know you guys talk so much about ball movement, and in that third quarter, nine assists on 12 made baskets. How important is that, especially the last couple of games the assist numbers weren't there?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: It's very important. We have a lot of weapons. Even with guys out, I think it shows our depth, shows that anyone can have the ball in their hands and make a play. And I think it's also just sticking to the game plan, knowing what the defense is going to give us.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells on the Grizzlies ball movement: We have a lot of weapons. Even with guys out it shows our depth and that anyone can have the ball in their hands and make a play.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells highlights the importance of ball movement and team depth in the Grizzlies' offensive success.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Wells
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Wells previews upcoming game against Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: We just got to play our game. That's it. I think if we play our game, we'll win.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Minnesota ended up winning tonight against Oklahoma City, so Friday's game comes down to the winner wins the group. You played them less than a week ago. What did you learn from that game that needs to be better this time around?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Wells
text_blocks.text: Defensively, I think we started off really good. We just got to play our game. That's it. I think if we play our game, we'll win.

quotes.social_post: Jaylen Wells on the upcoming matchup against Minnesota: We just have to play our game. If we play our game we will win.

structured.context: Jaylen Wells comments on the upcoming game against the Minnesota Timberwolves following their win over Oklahoma City.
